ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites: IE 300 or equivalent course This course provides an introduction to neural networks and recent advances in deep learning. Topics include training and implementation of neural networks, convolution neural networks, recurrent neural networks (LSTM and gated recurrent), residual networks, reinforcement learning, and Q-learning with neural networks. A part of the course will especially focus on recent work in deep reinforcemcent learning. The course will also cover the deep learning library PyTorch and how to train neural networks using GPUs and GPU clusters.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman, Sophomore, or Junior class standing.
